review: Regret Faust is a very good ID when it comes to dealing with a bunch of enemies or when the boss has multiple parts that can be hit separately. She does not need other Tremor IDs in a team to work as she is a good standalone. However, she needs Tremor Count to really show her prowess during combat as without it, or multiple targets, her damage and performance will go down. In situations when she is working, she performs excellently in the debuff and damage department. No particular E.G.O Synergies. While she does not fuel Fluid Sac E.G.O., it is still recommended to use it on her due to how great that E.G.O. is
